As Salaamu Alaikum. I had a dream and would like to have it interpreted Insha Allah. I was in a house with about 5 other people both male and female, I don't think any were Muslim except for me. Something broke and 2 went to the basement to fix it, while down there, the house exploded and everyone died. In my dream we were re-created and taken back to the time before the explosion without clear memory of what was to happen. We were reading a book with stories and it became clear to me that the book was reminding me what was going to happen. I knew it was the Will of Allah SWT so I didn't fight it or try to convince other people. Instead, when I recognised the time approaching for the explosion I rushed to make wudhu & make salah as I wanted to die in a state of salah. At the time of the explosion, nothing happened. I finished my prayer and went to see the other people. One man who had gone downstairs to fix the problem(as in the beginning) smiled at me and showed me his hand which was burnt. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 20726 Country: Pakistan Title: I have seen a dream in ramzan when i was in aitekaf... i saw 3 full moons on the sky lining up one after the other in a vertical line... all the 3 moons were complete of 15 days ( ROUND and Bright).. please give me a proper interpretation of this dream... Question: I have seen a dream in ramzan when i was in aitekaf... i saw 3 full moons on the sky lining up one after the other in a vertical line... all the 3 moons were complete of 15 days ( ROUND and Bright).. please give me a proper interpretation of this dream... Answer ID: 20726 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 385/385/M=1431) The dream means that they are good slaves of Almighty Allah. May Almighty Allah grant you success in meeting them, Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
